conceptZh: 玩具戰士用泡棉劍一彈一彈，每彈一次就掉下一筆，剛好數到三秒。
object: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, plus a bouncing stopwatch ball
morph: a bouncing ball ricochets three times, dropping the strokes of 秒
creativeAngle: 彈跳連鎖配三秒鐘：每一彈就是一秒。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale seafoam background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 秒 as the only text on screen, drawn in royal blue solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a stocky toy warrior with a foam sword swaggers in and whacks a round stopwatch ball; first 秒 spoken as the ball bounces off the left wall and the 禾 strokes drop in. 1.7-3.4s: the ball ricochets off his shield, pinging into the floor and ceiling; second 秒 as the 少 strokes land one by one with each bounce. 3.4-5s: 三秒鐘 is spoken as three quick bounces, one per syllable-beat, the warrior swinging and missing each time, falling flat on his shield. 5-8s: hold; the stopwatch settles at his feet and he stands up with a proud, dented pose. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "秒、秒、三秒鐘" (ㄇㄧㄠˇ、ㄇㄧㄠˇ、ㄙㄢ ㄇㄧㄠˇ ㄓㄨㄥ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 秒 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
